observations: Small, dark grey, heart-shaped portable speaker held in a hand.
Three control buttons are visible on the top surface: a power button, a volume up button, and a volume down button.
The speaker has a matte finish and appears to be a single-unit device.
A watermark 'POSTED ON JIJI B.VENTURES' is visible across the center of the image.

claims.claim: Voice Control via Alexa, Google, Siri
All keys and buttons working, adapter included. Bought from the UK, no dead key, no crackle.
claims.evidence: No photo shows this; it is the seller's word only.

risks.risk: The speaker may not power on or produce sound.
risks.proof: A video showing the speaker powered on and playing audio.

risks.risk: The internal battery may be dead or unable to hold a charge.
risks.proof: A video showing the speaker playing music while disconnected from a power source.

risks.risk: The device may be a counterfeit or a generic clone of a branded model.
risks.proof: A clear photo of the manufacturer's label or the model number on the device.

proof_requests: Close-up of any label, sticker or metal plate showing the brand and model.
Video of the speaker powered on and playing music.
Video showing the speaker connected to Wi-Fi and Bluetooth.
Photo of the charging port and the rear of the device.
response.reason: The item is known from the photos. What they cannot prove is priced at its worst case until the proof asked for below arrives.
